svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Engram: lookup and context-gated write schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Engram: lookup and context-gated write
svg.desc: Look up the hash rows, project a key for each residual stream and a shared value, then apply the signed-square-root gate. Authored adaptation of DeepSeek publisher code (MIT). Hash IDs are global table row IDs already produced by the publisher hash layout; tokenization, n-gram hashing, table sharding and FP8 row dequantization are outside this excerpt. Weights may use FP32 or BF16; projection and gate arithmetic use FP32 and output keeps the residual dtype. The token mask and normalization epsilon are required caller inputs; no checkpoint scalar default is implied. Publisher mapping is not production certification.

g.text: External global row IDs; hashing is outside this program
